text_block_list.text:
After <chrname>'s public training session,
a message from <support>
arrived on my smartphone.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, I believe I exchanged
thoughts with <support> about
<chrname>'s training a while back...
choice_data_list: (I gave them my contact info back then...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
They must be keeping an eye on <chrname>.
Especially since this public training
was supposed to be live-streamed online.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I replied to <support>
before I forgot!
